# contenir-asset

> Asset records, file storage, ImageMagick derivatives and view helpers for laminas-mvc, on contenir/contenir-db-model 2.x. PHP 8.3+. Version 2.x is not compatible with 1.x.

Key facts for code generation:

- The application defines `#[Table('asset')] final class Asset extends Contenir\Asset\Model\Entity\BaseAssetEntity` and adds only extra columns (e.g. `#[Column('entry_id')] public ?int $entryId = null;`). Set `'asset' => ['entity' => Asset::class]`.
- Properties are camelCase: `imageLg`, `mimeType`, `userId`, `assetId`. The 1.x `$asset->image_lg` style is gone.
- `AssetManager::addAsset($target, $user, $parent, $type)` copies owners' primary-key columns onto same-named asset columns. Targets implement `ResourceInterface`.
- `storeAsset($asset, $target, $type, $_FILES['x'] | $path, '1200x800'?)` copies the file, makes `-lg.jpg` and `-sm.jpg` derivatives when `asset.convert` is set, and saves.
- `updateAsset($asset, $user, ['title' => …])` takes PROPERTY names.
- `deleteAsset()` deletes the row only; `removeAsset()` deletes the files only.
- There is no `BaseAssetRepository` any more; query through `$assetManager` or `$em->getRepository(Asset::class)`.
